name: payments
title: Kybernesis Payments
description: A Link wallet for the agent on its owner's behalf: Stripe Link's tools (spend requests, approval links, reports) mounted behind the owner's link-cli sign-in, the person's approval in Link on every purchase, and pay_on_computer, which types the approved one-time card into a checkout on the agent's own computer without the model ever seeing it. Requires the computer item.
